The pop-up suggests other applications that the user might like, featuring six app icons with related themes, such as love, relationships, and possibly photo editing or social interaction. Each app icon has a distinct image, some depicting couples, hearts, or romantic scenes.

At the bottom of the pop-up, there are two buttons: "No Thanks" on the left and "OK" on the right, allowing the user to either decline or accept the suggestions. The background of the screen is slightly blurred, indicating that the pop-up is the active focus. The status bar at the top shows various icons, including notifications and the time (9:06).
